summary.text: Harold Pope is a Democrat who has served in the New Mexico Senate since 2021, representing District 23 in Bernalillo County.
Pope is vice chair of the Senate Education Committee and also sits on the Senate Health and Public Affairs Committee.

paragraphs.text: Pope's legislative page lists a district office in Albuquerque.

Between sessions, Pope chairs the Military and Veterans' Affairs Committee and is a member of the Radioactive and Hazardous Materials Committee and the Science, Technology and Telecommunications Committee.
